definitions.explanation: Used before nouns to indicate the most important, significant, or representative item(s) from a larger group.

examples.japanese: {主|おも}な{原因|げんいん}は{何|なん}ですか。
{主|おも}な{産業|さんぎょう}は{農業|のうぎょう}と{観光|かんこう}です。
examples.english: The main industries are agriculture and tourism.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}の{主|おも}な{議題|ぎだい}について{説明|せつめい}します。
examples.english: I will explain the main topics of the meeting.

notes:
A pre-noun adjectival ({連体詞|れんたいし}) that can only appear directly before a noun. Unlike な-adjectives, it cannot be used as a predicate (*これが{主|おも}なだ is ungrammatical). For predicate use, the related adjective {主|おも}に (mainly) serves as the adverbial form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主|おも}な{原因|げんいん}: main cause
- {主|おも}な{目的|もくてき}: main purpose
- {主|おも}な{理由|りゆう}: main reason
- {主|おも}な{特徴|とくちょう}: main features
- {主|おも}な{内容|ないよう}: main contents

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {主要|しゅよう}な: principal, major — more formal, used in written contexts and official documents
- {重要|じゅうよう}な: important — emphasizes significance rather than being the main one
- {中心的|ちゅうしんてき}な: central — emphasizes being at the center
